SELECT null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME finprodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ to_char(t.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') tradeDate,/**交易日**/ to_char(t.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') settleDate,/**交割日期**/ t.SHARE_AMT tradeNum,/**成交数量**/ t.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt,/**交易金额**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='32' where t.BUSI_TYPE ='32'
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and deal.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{finprodId}
and zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IN
#{asset}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND t.PS IN
#{ps}
order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ to_char(t.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') tradeDate,/**交易日**/ null paymentDate,/**缴款日**/ to_char(t.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') settdateDate,/**交割日**/ to_char(stl.SETTLE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') settleDate,/**交收日**/ null isLock, null endDate,/**锁定期截止日**/ t.SHARE_AMT dealNum,/**成交数量**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE tradeAmt,/**交易价格**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B05' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as commission,/**佣金**/ null stampDutyAmt,/**印花税**/ CASE WHEN ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B99' THEN ttfd.FEE_AMT ELSE 0 END as otherAmt,/**其他应付费用**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO myAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='32' LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID where t.BUSI_TYPE ='32' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
